name: engrama_score
description: EngramaBench's own typed scorer (entity w/ alias table, date +-7d, number +-5%, set F1, short-span F1, abstain, insight), loaded at runtime from the benchmark's repo clone under data/raw/engramabench/ -- not vendored. Per-item score as the scorer defines it; the reported number is its {composite_score, per-family scores}. Only meaningful on engramabench (needs item.metadata['engrama_query']); opted in via that dataset's extra_metrics.
